scope: SR-00 through SR-25 and SR-13A offline readiness audit

initial_findings.finding: Real local render was blocked behind fixture-only guard and had no Desktop hash-bound authorization.
initial_findings.resolution: Closed by a single-use authorization envelope, explicit Desktop click, exact source/plan/profile/constitution hashes, runtime Qt check, and idempotency lock.

initial_findings.finding: Desktop surface stopped before local render, QA, human review, and export.
initial_findings.resolution: Closed by the eight-stage dock workflow, QThread jobs, cancellation event, QA gate, tracked review session, and export action.

initial_findings.finding: Source metadata and persisted workflow state were not fully hash-bound for resumed work.
initial_findings.resolution: Closed by metadata hash revalidation at analyze, plan, render, persisted state invalidation, and deserializers with stale-state blocking.

initial_findings.finding: Canonical Desktop storage, no-overwrite behavior, and exported hash verification were absent.
initial_findings.resolution: Closed by discovered Desktop/SIRAJ Shorts root, stable episode identity, atomic export, v2 versioning, rebuild index, moved-root detection, and manifest hash equality.

initial_findings.finding: QA could pass constitutional dimensions through missing placeholder evidence and did not expose human face review as a hard boundary.
initial_findings.resolution: Closed by removing silent defaults, preserving HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED for FACE and UNSEEN, and requiring review-session evidence before real export.

initial_findings.finding: The native EP002 directory has ambiguous metadata candidates and no safe native smoke input was available.
initial_findings.resolution: Kept fail-closed; native admission reports BLOCK_AMBIGUOUS_SOURCE:EPISODE_METADATA. Video-plus-transcript is the explicit safe-input path.
